Clinical Research Center,Shanghai Children's Medical Center，Shanghai Jiao Tong University School of Medicine)ABSTRACT Objective: ( ) rational use of warfarin. Methods:Based on the drug interaction software LexiHInteractionTM,the drugs with obvious DDIs with warfarin and their safety classification information were screened. The case data of warfarin used in children in Shanghai Children's Medical Center affiliated to Shanghai Jiao Tong University School of Medicine from 2O14 to 2O18 were collcted，and the DDIs were analyzed.Results: Among the drugs that interacted with warfarin,8 drugs were at grade X and 41 drugs at grade D.A total of 433 children with warfarin treatment were selected.Among them，the main diagnosis was congenital heart disease（61.4%） and Kawasaki disease (18.2%). Totally 324 cases (74.8%） used the drugs with DDIs with warfarin. There were 277 cases treated with 1-3 drugs with DDIs at the same time.There were 11 drugs with DDIs with warfarin，all of which were at grade D.
